summary: The maybeAddErrorToSpan function in the OpenTelemetry interceptor crashes with TypeError when receiving undefined error values, creating infinite retry loops that mask the original error.
userImpact: Workflows that catch non-Error values crash with infinite retry loops, making applications unstable and impossible to debug.
rootCause: The code uses (err as Error).message which throws when err is undefined. The nullish coalescing operator ?? only guards the .message property, not the err object itself.
proposedFix: Use err instanceof Error ? (err.message ?? String(err)) : String(err ?? 'unknown error') to safely handle all error types.
keyQuote: The TypeError escapes wrapWithSpan and becomes the workflowTaskError... creating an infinite crash loop
